infrastructure.providers.codesphere.mark:
# Codesphere

> Xaaladda: Maajo 6, 2026. Diirada: qiimee akoontiga imtixaanka, soo bixi King kordhinta, oo si qotodheer u socodsii culeyska shaqada wicitaanka fiidyaha.

## Tusmada Tusmada

- [Shaqeynta profile](#operating-profile)
- [Fursadaha ballaarinta](#expansion-options)
- [King Kordhinta Kordhinta](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Is-bakhti-samaynta Wicitaannada Fiidyaha](#autoscaling-for-video-calls)
- [La socoshada OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [iimaylka iyo DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Qodobbada go'aanka](#decision-points)
- [Ilaha](#sources)

## Shaqeynta profile

Codesphere waxay faa'iido leedahay marka aan rabno dib-u-eegis dib loo soo saari karo oo aan tijaabinno bay'adaha si dhakhso leh annaga oo aan shaqeynin Kubernetes nafteena. Wax soo saarka, qaabka goobta shaqadu waa inuu ahaadaa ** Had iyo jeer Joogsigu kuma habboona bartilmaameedyada ku biirista wicitaanka sababtoo ah goobta shaqada ayaa laga yaabaa inay si dhakhso ah u bilowdo, laakiin abka wali waa inuu si nadiif ah ugu soo noqdaa marxaladda orodka.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  User[Browser / Mobile] --> Domain[app.kingrt.com]
  Domain --> Frontend[Codesphere Frontend Service]
  Frontend --> Api[API Service]
  Frontend --> Ws[WebSocket Service]
  Ws --> Sfu[SFU / Call Runtime]
  Api --> Store[(DB / Object Store)]
  Sfu --> Store
  Api --> OTel[OTel Collector]
  Ws --> OTel
  Sfu --> OTel
```

## Fursadaha ballaarinta

| Ikhtiyaarka | Isticmaal kiis | Awood is-qaadista | Khatar |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Goobta Shaqada ee Had iyo jeer-Kulan | Tijaabi xisaabta, demo, tusaale yar oo diyaarin ah | Toosan iyada oo loo marayo qorshaha kheyraadka; miisaanka siman waa qayb keliya oo faa'iido leh | Hal runtime, ma jiro SFU qaybin dhab ah |
| Soo koobid | Adeegyada HTTP/APIla aan dal lahayn | Ku-noqoshada waxa loo kordhin karaa si siman iyada oo loo marayo UI/API | Nidaamka faylalka la wadaago, wax qora ma jiro tartan |
| Landscapes | Adeegyo badan oo ku jira hal goob shaqo: Frontend, API, WS, SFU, worker | Adeegyada si gaar ah ayaa loo cabbiri karaa | Isgaarsiinta adeeggu waa inay isticmaashaa magacyada adeegga gudaha |
| Public API + King Orchestrator | Siideynta otomaatiga ah iyo hawlgallada cabbirka | Aasaaska King-controlled scale-out | Xaqiiji API sifooyin la taaban karo oo ku jira akoontiga tijaabada |
| Adeegyada stateful ee dibadda | DB, dukaanka walxaha, safka, boostada | Waxay ka goysaa replicas-ka nidaamka faylka goobta shaqada | Kala saar shabakadaha, siraha, iyo kaydinta |

## King Kordhinta Kordhinta

1. Ku xidh kaydka Codesphere goobta shaqada.
2. U deji goobta shaqada ** Had iyo jeer shid *** haddii deegaanku helo taraafikada wacitaanka.
3. Ku hay env vars halkii goob shaqo:
4. Ku ilaali `ci.yml` diyaarin, tijaabi, oo socodsii marxaladaha. Marxaladda orodku waa inay ku bilaabataa adeeg kasta si aan madmadow lahayn oo dib u bilaabmaa si toos ah shilalka kadib.
5. Kala qaybso muuqaalka: qeex qaybta hore, API, WebSocket, SFU, iyo shaqaalaha asalka ah inay yihiin adeegyo gaar ah.
6. U isticmaal Codesphere- magacyada adeegga gaarka ah ee isgaarsiinta gudaha, ee ma aha URL-yada guud.
7. Waligaa ha ku qorin loguska hal fayl la wadaago. Haddii diiwaannada faylalka ay lagama maarmaan tahay, u kala qaybi nuqulkiiba `CS_REPLICA`.

```yaml
prepare:
  steps:
    - name: install frontend
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm ci && npm run build
    - name: backend sanity
      command: ./demo/video-chat/backend-king-php/tests/smoke.sh
test:
  steps:
    - name: frontend contracts
      command: cd demo/video-chat/frontend-vue && npm run test:contract:client-diagnostics
run:
  steps:
    - name: king api
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-api.sh
    - name: king ws
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-ws.sh
    - name: king sfu
      command: ./ops/codesphere/run-sfu.sh
```

## Is-bakhti-samaynta Wicitaannada Fiidyaha

- **Ku biir bartilmaameedka:** Lobby-ka wac iyo calaamadeyntu waa inay ahaataa mid diiran. Had iyo jeer-On waa qasab ku biirinta ilbiriqsi hoosaadka.
- **Stateless API:** Codesphere nuqulo ku habboon haddii kalfadhiyada ay yihiin kuwo meel dhexe ansaxiyay oo faylasha maxalliga ah aan loo isticmaalin sidii gobol.
- **WebSocket:** Dariiq dhegdheg leh ama dukaanka fadhiga dhexe/joogitaanka ayaa loo baahan yahay. La'aanteed, isbeddellada nuqulku waxay u qaybiyaan gobolka wicitaanka si khaldan.
- **SFU:** Si indho la'aan ah ha ku celcelin. Qolalka waa in lagu meeleeyaa SFU jeex; King Orchestrator waa in uu kantaroolaa qol-ilaa-SFU marinka iyo biyo-mareenka
- ** Wac abka/shaqaalaha:** Musharrixiinta ka wanaagsan nuqullada jiifka ah marka ay shaqadu tahay kuwa awood leh oo safaf/quful toos ah ku leh meel ka baxsan goobta shaqada.
- **Nidaamka faylalka la wadaago:** Codesphere wadaag nuqul ka mid ah `/home/user/app`. Gobolka Runtime, jitter buffers, uploads, logs kuma jiraan halkaas.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser
  participant API as API Replica
  participant ORC as King Orchestrator
  participant SFU as SFU Shard
  participant O as Object Store
  B->>API: Join Call
  API->>ORC: allocate room / capabilities
  ORC->>SFU: reserve room
  SFU-->>ORC: room endpoint
  ORC-->>API: signed routing token
  API-->>B: ws/sfu endpoint
  B->>SFU: publish media
  SFU->>O: diagnostics / snapshots only
```

## La socoshada OpenTelemetry

- Wixii Codesphere, u dir OTLP si toos ah ururiyaha dibadda marka hore.
- Adeegyada App-ka ayaa dejiyay `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`, iyo `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`.
- Adeegso magacyo gaar ah adeeg kasta: `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, `king-callapp-worker`.
- Marka muuqaalku xasilo, OTel Ururiyaha wuxuu u shaqayn karaa sidii adeeg gudaha ah wuxuuna u dhoofin karaa Grafana/Tempo/Loki/Prometheus Qorista fog.

## iimaylka iyo DNS

- Ha ku ordin SMTP gudaha. Codesphere Goobaha shaqada waa in lagu soo diraa kaliya SMTP dibadeed ama bixiyaha boostada.
- Siraha ku kaydi env vars:
- Ku hay DNS si aad u hesho xayndaabka wax soo saarka ee u kala qaybsan abka/API/WS/SFU/CDN.
- Xaqiiji SPF, DKIM, iyo DMARC ku yaal bogga soo dirida ama boos-u-qabsiga iyo iimaylada rasaastu waxay ku dhacayaan spam.

## Qodobbada go'aanka

- Akoonka imtixaanku ma isticmaali karaa muuqaallo muuqaal ah?
- Ma jirtaa API marin u helidda nuqullada/qorshayaasha kheyraadka ee autoscaling?
- Sidee loogu oggolaaday boggaga gaarka ah iyo marin-u-socodka koontada?
- Waa maxay xadka lagu dabaqi karo CPU, RAM, kaydinta, nuqullada, iyo isku xirka WebSocket furan?
- SFU dekedaha iyo isku xidhka dhaadheer ee WebSocket ma u socon karaan si degan

# Hetzner

## Tusmada Tusmada

- [Shaqeynta profile](#operating-profile)
- [Fursadaha ballaarinta](#expansion-options)
- [King Kordhinta Kordhinta](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Moodeelka otomaatiga ah](#autoscaling-model)
- [La socoshada OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [iimaylka iyo DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Ilaha](#sources)

## Shaqeynta profile

Hetzner waa jidka tooska ah ee Kaabayaasha-Adeeg ahaan. Waxaan helnaa server-ka API-wada, culeyska culeyska, shabakadaha, dab-damiska, IP-yada sabeynaya, iyo mugga. Taasi waxay ka dhigaysa Hetzner ikhtiyaarka ugu fiican ee King marka aan rabno inaan xakameyno nafteena.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Internet --> LB[Hetzner Load Balancer]
  LB --> FE[Frontend/API Pool]
  LB --> WS[WebSocket Pool]
  LB --> SFU[SFU Pool]
  FE --> DB[(Postgres / Redis)]
  WS --> Redis[(Presence / Session Store)]
  SFU --> Obj[(Object Store)]
  ORC[King Orchestrator] --> HCLOUD[Hetzner Cloud API]
  HCLOUD --> FE
  HCLOUD --> WS
  HCLOUD --> SFU
```

## Fursadaha ballaarinta

| Ikhtiyaarka | Isticmaal kiis | Iskeelka gadaasha | Talo soo jeedin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keliya server + Docker Samee | Duuliye degdeg ah | Buugga/API ku salaysan | Dev/diyaarinta kaliya |
| 2-3 server + Hetzner Isku-dheelitirka Load | HA ee hore ee hore/API/WS | King Orchestrator-ku wuxuu cabbiraa kooxaha server-ka iyada oo loo marayo API | Tallaabo dhexdhexaad ah oo wanaagsan |
| k3s/Talos/Kubernetes ku yaal Hetzner | Pod HPA, KEDA, xoqid qanjirada | Xoog badan, laakiin waanu ku shaqaynaa | Qaabka bartilmaameedka ee cabirida wicitaanka fiidyowga |
| Adeegga xididka u go'ay + daruur LB | Waxqabadka go'an ee SFU | Buugga ama King Orchestrator | U fiican in la saadaaliyo SFU awoodda |
| Isku-dhafan: Codesphere horudhac, Hetzner prod | Horudhac degdeg ah + wax soo saarka la xakameeyey | Horudhac gaar ah, prod API-lagu wado | Pragmatic |

## King Kordhinta Kordhinta

1. U samee sawirada salka `king-api`, `king-ws`, `king-sfu`, iyo `king-worker`.
2. Adeegaha adeegaha ee leh summada: `role=api`, `role=ws`, `role=sfu`, `env=prod`.
3. U isticmaal shabakad gaar ah API/WS/SFU/DB; kaliya load balancers waa dadweynaha.
4. Firewall: kaliya 80/443 dadwayne, SSH kaliya laga helo maamulka IP/VPN, dekedaha gudaha oo keliya shabakada gaarka ah.
5. Soo rogo King kordhinta adeeg habaysan ama Kubernetes dirid
6. Diiwaangeli SFU jeexjeexyo leh cabbirka awoodda: CPU, RAM, qolal firfircoon, daabac FPS, heerka soo kabashada.
7. Ku dar biyo-mareenka: jooji meelaynta qolal cusub, ha dhammayn wicitaanada jira, ka dibna ka saar noodhka.

## Moodeelka otomaatiga ah

- **Heerka boodhka:** Kubernetes HPA loogu talagalay API/WS/shaqaale, KEDA loogu talagalay shaqaalaha safka ama dhacdada wado.
- ** Heerka Node:** Kooxda Autoscaler ama King orchestrator iyada oo loo marayo Hetzner Cloud API.
- **SFU heerka:** Calaamadaha gaarka ahi waxay ka muhiimsan yihiin CPU: daabacayaasha firfircoon, durdurrada dibadda ka baxa, cadaadiska codeeyaha, waddooyinka soo kabashada, RTT, iyo luminta xirmada.
- ** Wac abka:** cabirka barkadda shaqaalaha; shaqadu waa inay ahaadaan kuwo awood leh.
- **Bakhaarka walxaha:** soo raritaanka, avatars-ka, sawirada gadaasha, iyo farshaxanada waa in aanay ku noolaan saxannada deegaanka.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> WarmPool
  WarmPool --> ScaleOut: rooms > threshold or recovery pressure
  ScaleOut --> RegisterNode: hcloud create server
  RegisterNode --> AcceptRooms: health + otel ready
  AcceptRooms --> Drain: low demand or maintenance
  Drain --> DeleteNode: active rooms = 0
  DeleteNode --> WarmPool
```

## La socoshada OpenTelemetry

- Kubernetes: OTel Collector sida DaemonSet ee node/pod logs iyo deployment loogu talagalay cluster metrics.
- VM/Compose: OTel Collector node kasta sida systemd service ama container.
- Metrikyada loo baahan yahay: `call.join.latency`, `sfu.publisher.count`, `sfu.recovery.routes`, `ws.session.reconnects`, `object_store.upload.duration`, `mail.send.duration`.
- Bartilmaameedka export-ka: external OTLP collector marka hore; kadib observability stack noo gaar ah.

## Iimayl iyo DNS

- Transactional mail ha maro external SMTP ama adeeg mail gaar ah.
- Ku deji SPF, DKIM, iyo DMARC domain-ka diraya.
- DNS si nadiif ah u kala saar: `app`, `api`, `ws`, `sfu`, `cdn`, `otel`.
- Ha soo bandhigin ports random ah oo SFU ah; ku mari TLS/WebSocket endpoints qeexan.

## Ilaha

- [Hetzner Cloud API Dulmar](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/)
- [Hetzner Isku-dheelitirnaanta Load](https://docs.hetzner.com/networking/load-balancers/overview/)
- [Hetzner Daruur API: Isticmaalka API](https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/)
- [Hetzner Cloud Controller Manager](https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-cloud-controller-manager)
- [Kubernetes Iskoorka baabuurta](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/)
- [Kubernetes Iskeelka Node-ka](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/cluster-administration/node-autoscaling/)

# Intares

## Tusmada Tusmada

- [Shaqeynta profile](#operating-profile)
- [Fursadaha ballaarinta](#expansion-options)
- [King Kordhinta Kordhinta](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Xaqiiqda Autoscaling](#autoscaling-reality)
- [La socoshada OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [iimaylka iyo DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Su'aalaha loogu talagalay Intares](#questions-for-intares)
- [Ilaha](#sources)

## Shaqeynta profile

Iyada oo ku saleysan dukumeenti dadweyne ee hadda, Intares waxay u egtahay martigelin la maamulay/lamaane server la maamulay oo leh serfarada go'doonsan, kaydinta, maamulka, iyo dejinta Docker/daruur gaar ah oo ikhtiyaari ah. Taasi waxay u fiican tahay kaabayaal heegan ah oo shaqeeya. Nashqada is-adeegga ah API qaab isugeynta sida Hetzner ama PaaS lakab nuqul ah sida Codesphere si guud looma diiwaangelin ku filan oo lagu tiirsado.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  King[King Platform Team] --> Runbook[Runbook + Release Bundle]
  Runbook --> Intares[Intares Managed Ops]
  Intares --> Nodes[Managed Server / Private Cloud]
  Nodes --> Apps[King API / WS / SFU / Worker]
  Apps --> Observability[OTel + Alerts]
  Observability --> King
```

## Fursadaha ballaarinta

| Ikhtiyaarka | Isticmaal kiis | Iskeelka gadaasha | Khatar |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hal server la maamulay | Wax soo saar yar ayaa bilaabmaya | Toosan/Manual | Ma jiro wax ka qabasho laastikada wacitaanka |
| Labada HA la maamulay | API/website-ka oo guuldarraystay | Buug-gacmeedka | SFU Jideynta waa in la caddeeyo |
| Docker ku yaal server-yada la maamulo | Dib loo soo saari karo King adeegyo | Qoraal/API kaliya haddii karti loo yeesho | Caddee xuduudaha hawlwadeenada |
| Adeegga daruuraha gaarka ah | Kooxda macaamiisha-gaar ah | Macquul ah, laakiin heshiis/shaqaale | Malaha male la'aanteed |
| Intares + Hetzner/Codesphere hybrid | La maareeyay DB/ammaanka + shaqaalaha app-elastic meel kale | Dibeda King orchestra | Si nadiif ah u qor shabakada/GDPR xuduudaha |

## King Kordhinta Kordhinta

1. Intares waxay ka helaysaa xidhmo sii dayn qaabaysan ama sawirada weelka ee diiwaankayaga.
2. Waxaan bixinaa halbeeg habaysan ama Compose/Kubernetes muujinta API, WS, SFU, iyo shaqaale.
3. Siraha laguma soo raro xidhmada; waxay ku jiraan Intares sirta/habaynta serverka.
4. Baaritaannada caafimaadka waa in si gaar ah loo gaari karaa iyadoo la eegayo Intares kormeeraha iyo King abaabulaha.
5. Kaydka: xaji DB kaydinta si joogto ah, u beddelo bakhaarka shayga, hana dib u celin kaydiyayaasha runtime maxaliga ah.
6. Dib-u-soo-celinta: hayso sawirkii hore/ xidhmo ka hor oo qiimee guuritaanka xogta xogta adigoo isticmaalaya xeelad hoose ka hor.

## Xaqiiqda Autoscaling

- Haddii aan la helin API adeeg iskaa-u-yeel ah la'aanteed, waa in aynaan u qorshayn Intares bartilmaameed toos ah oo miisaan-saar ah.
- Wicitaan fiidyowgu waxay u baahan yihiin ugu yaraan fikrad barkada diiran ama wakhtiyada falcelinta hawlwadeenka oo dammaanad qaaday.
- SFU Is-dheellitirka waa in loo qorsheeyaa sidii barkad mug leh: jeexjeexyo go'an oo lagu daray bixinta buug-gacmeed ama si toos ah oo qandaraas ah.
- Haddii Intares ay bixiso Kubernetes/daruur gaar ah, Kubernetes xeerar ayaa khuseeya:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant K as King Orchestrator
  participant M as Monitoring
  participant I as Intares Ops
  participant N as Managed Node
  M->>K: capacity pressure
  K->>I: scale request / ticket / API if available
  I->>N: provision or resize
  N-->>K: health ready
  K->>N: assign new rooms
```

## La socoshada OpenTelemetry

- OTel Ururiya sidii adeeg habaysan ama weel saaran martigeliyaha kasta.
- Intares la socodka waxay u socon kartaa si isbar-bar socda, laakiin King waxay u baahan tahay OTLP xogteeda gaarka ah ee cabbirida gaarka ah ee wacitaanka.
- U dig labada dhinac: hawlwadeenka martida loo yahay/shabakadda/diskiska, King kooxda wicida cabbirada iyo khaladaadka abka.

## iimaylka iyo DNS

- Haddii Intares ay ku shaqeyso boostada: caddeyso SPF/DKIM/DMARC oo si qoraal ah ula socodsiiso.
- Haddii dibadda SMTP loo isticmaalo: ku kaydi shahaadooyinka sirta la maareeyey oo dukumeenti diritaanka dhinacayaga.
- Qeex DNS aagga iyo lahaanshaha shahaado ka hor inta aan la baahin.

## Su'aalaha loogu talagalay Intares

- Ma jiraa API server/firewall/LB/DNS/ hawlgallada cabbirka?
- Ma la bixiyaa Docker Abuur, Kubernetes, ama abaabulka daruuraha gaarka loo leeyahay?
- Sidee loo hawlgeliyaa soo-celinta iyo dib-u-celinta?
- Waa maxay SLA khuseysa qiyaasidda ogeysiiska gaaban?
- Ma maamuli karnaa
- Sidee loo maamulaa WebSocket iyo SFU isku xirka muddada-dheer ee culeyska culeyska?

## Ilaha

# mittwald

## Tusmada Tusmada

- [Shaqeynta profile](#operating-profile)
- [Fursadaha ballaarinta](#expansion-options)
- [King Kordhinta Kordhinta](#king-extension-rollout)
- [Qiimaynta Autoscaling](#autoscaling-assessment)
- [La socoshada OpenTelemetry](#monitoring-with-opentelemetry)
- [iimaylka iyo DNS](#email-and-dns)
- [Ilaha](#sources)

## Shaqeynta profile

mittwald waxay ku siisaa haynta weelka mStudio wata UI, CLI, API, iyo Terraform. Weelasha waxaa laga bilaabi karaa diiwaanka, waxaa loo geyn karaa sidii xirmo, lagu habeeyay env vars, mugga, iyo dekedo, oo lagu soo bandhigo goobaha/soo gelida. Taasi waxay ku xoogan tahay mareegaha, API, shaqaale, iyo adeegyo yaryar. Si loo gaaro bartilmaameedyada adag SFU autoscaling, waxaan wali u baahanahay inaan tijaabino in agabka iyo tusaalooyinka si toos ah loo xakameyn karo.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  Registry[Image Registry] --> MW[mStudio / CLI / Terraform]
  MW --> Stack[Container Stack]
  Stack --> Frontend[Frontend Container]
  Stack --> Api[API Container]
  Stack --> Worker[Worker Container]
  Stack --> Collector[OTel Collector Container]
  Domain[Domain / Ingress] --> Frontend
  Frontend --> Api
  Api --> Worker
```

## Fursadaha ballaarinta

| Ikhtiyaarka | Isticmaal kiis | Iskeelka gadaasha | Talo soo jeedin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mStudio Konteenar | Habaynta gacanta, imtixaanada degdega ah | Buugga | Barta gelitaanka wanaagsan |
| `mw container run` | Hawlgelin qoraal ah | Qori karo | Loogu talagalay runbooks |
| `mw stack deploy` | Isku-duubyo-ku-waafaqsan | Ku-salaysan | U fiican API/shaqaale |
| Terraform Bixiye | Kaabayaasha qaabaysan | La qorsheyn karo, dib loo eegi karo | Loo door biday deegaan la soo saari karo |
| API Cusboonaysiinta Sawirka | Siidaynta duuban/jiidista summada beddelmi karta | Toos ah | Faa'iido u leh CI/CD |

## King Kordhinta Kordhinta

1. U dhis sawirada weelka adeegyada King oo ku riix GitHub/GitLab/DockerHub/diiwaangelinta gaarka ah.
2. Qeex mittwald xirmada weelka: API, WS, shaqaale, ururiye ikhtiyaari ah.
3. U isticmaal galitaanka dadweynaha oo kaliya xagga hore/API/WS; ku xidho adeegyada gudaha iyada oo loo marayo magacyada gudaha DNS.
4. U isticmaal mugga kaliya xogta si cad oo joogto ah. Runtime baffers iyo jitter buffers waxay joogaan RAM.
5. Geli calaamadaha sawirka aan bedeli karin: `king-api:1.0.8`, `king-ws:1.0.8`, `king-worker:1.0.8`.
6. Ku soo bixi siideynta `mw container update --image...` ama Terraform doorsoome `image_tag`.

```bash
mw container run \
  --name king-api \
  --env KING_ENV=production \
  --env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.example.com \
  -p 8080:8080/tcp \
  registry.example.com/king-api:1.0.8
```

## Qiimaynta Autoscaling

- API iyo shaqaalaha si fiican ayaa weel loogu shubi karaa.
- Fiidiyowga SFU, tijaabi isku xirnaanta muddada dheer, CPU boos sii qabsasho, habdhaqanka dekedda/soo galitaanka, iyo kontoroolka tusaalaha jiifka ah.
- La'aanteed sifada autoscaling dhalad ah oo diiwaansan, qorshee mittwald sidii bartilmaameed weel la maareeyey oo leh miisaan la kontoroolo iyada oo la marayo API/Terraform, ma aha sidii mid toos ah SFU autoscaler.
- Barnaamijyada wicitaanku waxay ku socon karaan weelal badan oo shaqaale ah haddii safafka/qufuladu ay ku nool yihiin meel ka baxsan goobta weelka.

## La socoshada OpenTelemetry

- Ka Dhoofinta OTel si toos ah weel kasta una dhoofisa dibadda.
- Taas beddelkeeda, u socodsii ururiyaha sidii weel u gaar ah oo ku dhex jira xirmada haddii gudaha gudaha la gaari karo ay deggan tahay.
- Ku ilaali diiwaannada gudaha mStudio, laakiin ha u isticmaalin isha kaliya ee ogaanshaha.

## iimaylka iyo DNS

- Ku soo dir boostada dibadda SMTP/ bixiye macaamil ganacsi ama mittwald boostada kaliya kadib hubinta keenista.
- U deji SPF/DKIM/DMARC bogga soo diraya.
- Khariidadda goobaha dadweynaha ee ku jira mStudio ilaa weelasha/gudbinta: `app`, `api`, `ws`, ikhtiyaari `cdn`

## Ilaha
